off.settings.ui_resolution: the interface resolution chooser needs the overlay of overlay/v1/z9x_uires (ro.z9x.uires.allow), which no X50 family recipe ships, and the 1.3.38 stock trees have no such row: open until that overlay is ported
off.settings.stats: the statistics switch has two owners today (Z9X and HB ask the updater's provider content://org.lumen.updater, Play 6 writes lumen-stats PrefsState itself): a third X50 copy would make it worse, the row becomes one module row for every model once one owner is chosen
off.settings.diagnostics: the diagnostics text of Z9X, HB and Play 6 is their HalController readout: the X50 adapter has no such reader yet, and its sensors and signal readouts are on the For developers page already
